subject: Human Body
title: Language and the Brain
description: A quick win: understand Language and the Brain.

hook.text: Two tiny brain areas give you language. Damage one and you can't speak. Damage the other and you can't understand.

buildup.text: Broca's area in the left frontal lobe produces speech. Patients with damage understand language but can't form words.

discovery.text: Wernicke's area in the temporal lobe comprehends language. Damage creates fluent but nonsensical speech.

twist.text: A fiber bundle called the arcuate fasciculus connects both areas.

climax.text: Bilingual brains show denser gray matter. Learning a second language physically builds brain tissue.

punchline.text: Two patches of brain, one wire between them. That's language.

quiz.question: What happens when Wernicke's area is damaged?
options: Reading ability is lost but speech is fine
